event_time_fields.date: event date (FDA action date; registry update date for ClinicalTrials.gov)
event_time_fields.source_updated: openFDA dataset update date, or the registry record's update date; not a per-event publication time for openFDA
event_time_fields.first_seen_at: first time our published data held the event (this list, or the source feed's bot-state commit for SOURCE_HISTORY); null = before tracking and not provable
event_time_fields.first_seen_basis: THIS_RUN | CARRIED | SOURCE_HISTORY (commit in first_seen_evidence) | SOURCE_ADDED (source new or returning in this run; not a detection) | BEFORE_TRACKING
event_time_fields.event_at: same as date: when the event happened per the source
event_time_fields.source_published_at: same as source_updated: when the source published or updated it
event_time_fields.first_observed_at: when a fetch of ours held it: generated_at written by the fetching run into the first source-feed version that contained it; null = not provable
event_time_fields.first_observed_basis: SOURCE_FEED_FETCH | FIRST_FETCH_OF_SOURCE (observed at the source's first fetch; may be older than the source being added) | NOT_RECORDED | UNKNOWN
event_time_fields.first_published_at: when our published data first held it (feed commit on bot-state, or this list)

size_rules.market_cap: UNVERIFIED: shares outstanding x a current price from a permitted source (none configured)
size_rules.public_float_value: SEC dei:EntityPublicFloat: USD held by non-affiliates at the second fiscal quarter end; not market cap and not a share count
size_rules.sec_filer_status: SEC submissions filer category; a disclosure regime, not a market-cap class
size_rules.known_large_issuer_list: manual reference list used only to exclude obvious large issuers; reviewed against SEC filer status
size_rules.note_ar: التصنيف السوقي غير متحقق: القيمة السوقية تحتاج سعرًا حاليًا من مصدر مسموح. قيمة Public Float من SEC بالدولار وتصنيف الإفصاح أدلة منفصلة، وليست تصنيف Small Cap. انخفاض السعر اختبار منفصل.

ranking_rules.note_ar: الدرجة أولوية مراجعة للمحفز الرسمي، وليست توقعًا لاتجاه السعر أو احتمال ربح.

price_confirmation.rule: under $10 only from a quote <= 20 min old with public display rights
price_confirmation.note_ar: لا نصنّف أي سهم تحت 10$ ولا نؤكد إشارة سعرية دون سعر حديث من مصدر يسمح بالنشر.

clinical_registry_attribution: Courtesy of the U.S. National Library of Medicine
notes_ar: سجلات ClinicalTrials.gov لا تثبت نجاح العلاج أو اتجاه السعر؛ لا تأييد من NLM وقد لا تعكس آخر تعديل.
قائمة متابعة محفزات رسمية وليست توصيات ولا إشارات دخول.
أهمية المحفز تعني أولوية المراجعة، لا اتجاه السعر.
